host.hardware: Apple M3 Pro, 19,327,352,832 bytes RAM, 12 logical CPUs

configuration.measurement: tracemalloc live retained and peak allocations

compact_representation.construction: Vertices(1000000, member_list) for A and B; source lists then released

caller_set_conversion.construction: System converts two already-created dense sets to Vertices
caller_set_conversion.note: Peak includes old sets and replacement arrays simultaneously; canonical builder avoids this route for dense partitions.

limits: Only A/B partition objects are measured; no graph, matching, cache, phase or process RSS is included.
One host and one allocation shape; this does not qualify update throughput or durability.
Sparse partitions intentionally remain Python sets; the compact position array is universe-sized.
Million-vertex end-to-end paper qualification and billion-vertex support are not established.
